scenario.name: Red Hat, CISA & MITRE DFIR — Linux auditd SSH authorized_keys & PAM Module Persistence Forensics
scenario.overview: Imagine an underground city subway metro station with tiled tunnel walls, glowing route maps, chrome fare turnstiles, ticket kiosks, and a gleaming metro train sliding along the platform. Down in the underground subway concourse, a rider taps a replayed magnetic metro fare card at the chrome turnstile bank during evening rush hour. In this real-world scenario, the intruder quietly copies a trusted access pass from the metro station agent's station, then quietly copies a trusted access pass from the metro station agent's station. The metro booth attendant’s fare-gate console flags a single card swiped at two distant stations within seconds and alerts transit security. In this scenario (T1098.004, Red Hat, CISA & MITRE DFIR, Linux auditd SSH authorized_keys & PAM Module Persistence Forensics), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: linux Auditd File-Watch Trigger, then pAM Shared Library Modification Detection, then correlating /var/log/secure Accepted. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering Linux Auditd File-Watch Trigger, then PAM Shared Library Modification Detection, then Correlating /var/log/secure Accepted, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection pivots on auditd Event 257 correlated across the documented kill chain.

stages.title: Stage 1: Linux Auditd File-Watch Trigger on ~/.ssh/authorized_keys Modification (SYSCALL openat)
stages.subtitle: Persistence (T1098.004 - Account Manipulation: SSH Authorized Keys)
stages.description: Down in the underground subway concourse, a rider taps a replayed magnetic metro fare card at the chrome turnstile bank during evening rush hour. Specifically in Step 1, the intruder quietly copies a trusted access pass from the metro station agent's station while everyday visitors and the metro station agent go about their routine.
